# New-ZbxRole

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a user role.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxRole [[-Name] <string>] [[-Type] <ZabbixRoleType>] [-Rules <ZabbixRoleRuleRequest>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A user role sets what its users may see and do: the user type, the frontend sections, the API methods and the actions they may run. The New-ZbxRole cmdlet sends role.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new user role back with role.get and writes it. The server requires -Name and -Type; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a user role

```powershell
New-ZbxRole -Name 'Read-only operators' -Type User
```

Creates a user role named Read-only operators. The command writes the new user role, read back from the server.
